name: page-backlog-repository
config_yaml:
version: 1
mode: local
policy:

  max_passes_per_cycle: 3
  max_files_changed_per_pr: 200
  max_prs_per_day: 25
reviewer:
  harness: claude
  model: reviewer-model
resolver:
  harness: claude
  model: resolver-model
backlog:
  destination: repository
author: tester
